newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: INSIGHT - Some Dutch chartists see AEX uptrend.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Some Dutch chartists see AEX uptrend.

text.p: Dutch chartists were split about the near-term trend of the AEX index of 25 leading Dutch shares, with some veering away from their neutral stances taken up before the Christmas and New Year holiday period.

The AEX ended at 646.69 points on Friday, barely changed on the 645.95 of the previous Friday, although it climbed to an all-time high of 654.61 on at the beginning of last week. In the week before that the index had gained about seven points.
Contributor Trend Pvs view Support Resistance

ABN AMRO - The AEX meets intermediate resistance at the 652.50 level, while the all-time high of 654.60 is the main barrier for the bulls to focus on. The market has formed a short term bottom at 646.75. Within these boundaries the AEX doesn't offer us much potential.

If prices succeed in breaking out of this range, we advise to follow the market with small positions and to place close trailing exit-stops. As long as the index fails to find clear direction in the medium term staying neutral is the best strategy.
ING Barings - The uptrend of the AEX remains intact. Last Friday the market successfully tested its support at 646, at the lower reaches of its fast rising trend channel.

Momentum still in positive territory suggests only limited downside potential. Money flow is still positive, though lagging at little. Strong money flow indicates that investors remain active on the buy side of thhe market.

For this week we expect a test of the upper side of the rising trend channel of the AEX at around 660-665. All in all, the technicals of the AEX remain mildly bullish, but from a medium term perspective warn against too much optimism.

MeesPierson - We expect the market to move sideways this week in a trading range with support at 635 and resistance at 654. Due to the (options) expirations (on Friday) volatility is expected to stay high as well.

The long-term trend is still up although it is weakening due to increasing negative divergences. Momentum indicators in particular are deteriorating on a weekly basis. The long-term positive trend could be broken this month for a mild correction into the 590-600 area.

Iris - We expect the AEX Index to continue its uptrend this week and break the resistance level provided by the all time high at 655. The next target for the move will be the upper boundary of the rising channel, currently around 660.
Breaking the low at 641 will neutralise the rising trend.
